name: M6.RecipeIsometries.multiply_laws
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) (a : M6.RecipeIsometries.Block N), M6.RecipeIsometries.multiply N 1 a = a ∧ M6.RecipeIsometries.multiply N (u⁻¹) (M6.RecipeIsometries.multiply N u a) = a ∧ (M6.RecipeIsometries.multiply N u a = 0 ↔ a = 0)
guidance: The inverse coefficient-index permutation uses the unit inverse. Unfold multiply and simplify inv_inv, units val_mul/val_inv_mul and multiplication associativity. Infer zero iff by applying the inverse. This is an exponent multiplier, not multiplication of a word by an arbitrary polynomial unit. Return tactic proof lines without leading by, retaining the exact frozen statement and default limits.
